Description: The figure is a bar chart showing the distribution of the number of traffic participant instances per image across four datasets: Cityscapes, KITTI, MS COCO, and Pascal. The x-axis represents the number of traffic participant instances per image, divided into bins (0, 1-9, 19-27, 37-45, 55-63, 73-81, >90). The y-axis shows the number of images. The KITTI dataset has the highest number of images in the 19-27 bin, while Pascal has the highest number in the 37-45 bin. The lowest number of images is observed in the >90 bin across all datasets.
